fact_previews: Daily Vibes is an iOS app designed to help users take control of their modern, fast-paced life and improve their mindfulness, organization, and productivity.
The project was created by Alex Kluew.
The funding period for Daily Vibes was from November 27, 2017, to December 12, 2017.
Daily Vibes had a funding goal of CA$ 149.
The project received CA$ 205 from 9 backers.
